caption: The drawing depicts an octagonal tray with a wide, flat rim and a slightly recessed central area. The central area of the tray is solid black, while the rim is decorated with a colorful pattern featuring red and pink flowers, green leaves, brown swirling leaf or feather motifs, and orange or peach-colored fruit or floral elements. Surrounding this inner floral band is a thick, solid-black border that runs around the angled perimeter of the tray. The illustration includes a simple, linear side-profile view of the tray below the main image, showing its shallow depth, and a horizontal scale marked in inches is present at the bottom left. The name "Mildred Ford" is written at the bottom right of the drawing. The drawing is rendered on a plain, neutral background.
title: Toleware Tray
